opening.argument: The presentation is an investigation into allegations involving FTX and Alameda Research, not a solicitation of money, data, or viewer participation. Its title identifies the subject as an exposure, while the narration attributes the central account to Jesse Powell and describes an alleged hard-coded Alameda Research account with a perpetually negative balance and an unlimited credit limit. It further reports the allegation that customer funds were taken and spent on bribes and marketing. The supplied visuals reinforce those reported subjects with the words “CREDIT LIMIT” and “MARKETING.” Nothing in the presented material promotes an offer or asks viewers to take a consequential action; it explains alleged misconduct and warns viewers about it.
